ModMetaData.name: 天工铸造：自动化中枢材料消耗修复
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
修复天工铸造自动化中枢消耗整堆材料时的 Collection was modified 异常。仅让 TryConsumeGatheredMaterials 遍历地图物资列表的快照，保留原材料筛选、扣料、配方及生产进度逻辑。不改工坊原件或存档，不返还修复前已经损失的材料。
Fixes automation-hub material enumeration when consuming an entire stack. Only snapshots the map material list inside TryConsumeGatheredMaterials; original filtering, consumption and production remain unchanged. Does not edit Workshop files or saves, or refund previously lost materials.
